queue.title: Tax Planning Throughout the Business Year
queue.content:
A tax liability calculated only at year-end leaves too little room for legal optimisation measures. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

A tax liability calculated only at year-end leaves too little room for legal optimisation measures that need time to implement.

A tax liability calculated only at year-end leaves too little room for legal optimisation measures that need time to implement.

Many legal tax-optimisation measures — investment timing, timing of revenue and expense recognition — need to be implemented before year-end, not after.

A quarterly tax-liability projection, rather than only an annual calculation, gives enough time to identify optimisation opportunities while they're still actionable.

Companies that treat their tax liability as a result rather than an actively planned variable regularly miss legal savings available through timely planning.

Collaboration between the finance function and tax advisor throughout the year, not just during filing season, builds a discipline that pays off long-term.

queue.title: Securing API Interfaces in Business Integrations
queue.content:
An API interface open to partners carries the same risk as an internal system, yet rarely gets the same scrutiny. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

An API interface open to partners carries the same security risk as an internal system, but rarely receives the same level of scrutiny.

An API interface open to partners carries the same security risk as an internal system, but rarely receives the same level of scrutiny.

Growth in the number of business integrations also means growth in the number of API interfaces exposed to external partners, each representing a potential entry point for unauthorised access.

Authentication based solely on a static API key, without rotation or scope restriction, remains a common but risky practice in rapidly developed integrations.

Limiting each API key to a precisely defined scope of data and operations, with regular rotation, minimises the damage from an eventual key leak.

Logging and regular review of API calls reveals unusual access patterns before they escalate into an actual security incident.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/securing-api-interfaces-in-business-integrations/

queue.title: Managing Exporter Bank Guarantees
queue.content:
A bank guarantee ties up a company's credit line even if never activated, a hidden cost rarely tracked. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

A bank guarantee ties up a company's credit line even when it's never activated, and that hidden cost is rarely tracked systematically.

A bank guarantee ties up a company's credit line even when it's never activated, and that hidden cost is rarely tracked systematically.

A performance or advance-payment guarantee doesn't formally represent a cost until activated, but ties up part of a company's credit line just as real debt would.

Companies holding multiple active guarantees toward different clients at once often lose track of their total tied-up exposure to banks.

A centralised registry of all issued guarantees, with expiry dates and activation conditions, enables an accurate assessment of remaining credit capacity at any moment.

Timely release of expired or no-longer-needed guarantees frees up credit space for new business without requiring additional negotiation with the bank.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/managing-exporter-bank-guarantees/
